scope: Retain linked-cell metadata and ATTDEF tuples read within content records while keeping unresolved content association and graph/output profiles explicitly incomplete.

method.kind: ODA-field-order generated in-memory parser vectors plus DXF writer refusal guard

localTests.command: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_object_vectors_tests libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests dwg2dxf lc3_compat_check -j4

method.evidenceRule: The locally generated vectors verify parser field retention and selected output refusal behavior only; they are not producer interoperability or independent semantic support evidence.

model.attributes: ATTDEF handle, text, and index are retained in the cell-level DRW_TableCell::m_attributes vector, but the owning m_contents ordinal is not yet represented; any cell with these attributes remains semantically incomplete.
model.semantics: The snapshot remains export-incomplete for linked data until DATALINK dispatch, object ownership, references, and writer remapping are closed. Content-item attributes remain export-incomplete until both content association and the DXF TABLE writer route are closed.
model.writerSafety: The generic DXF TABLE writer refuses non-default linked fields rather than silently omitting them.
model.publicLayout: DRW_TableCell public layout changed; downstream consumers must rebuild. No DRW_Interface virtual was added.

controls.payload: DATALINK hard pointer 0xA710, row count 2, column count 3, opaque BL96 value 0x55
assertions: The standalone object is structurally parsed but semantically incomplete.
The DRW_TableCell retains the link flag, handle, counts, and BL96 value.

controls.payload: ATTDEF handle 0xA711, UTF-8 text Attribute2007, index 1
assertions: The typed cell attribute tuple is retained.
Cell copy preserves the fields and TABLECONTENT reset clears the payload.

controls.payload: null versus malformed bounded DATALINK handle; wrong soft-pointer role for the DATALINK hard pointer; non-Boolean linked-data flag; cell attribute counts 10000 and 10001
assertions: A null handle is distinct from a failed bounded handle read.
A DATALINK handle encoded with the ATTDEF soft-pointer role is rejected.
BL92 values other than 0/1 are rejected without invalidating the inline TABLE prefix.
The at-limit but body-impossible attribute count and over-limit count do not publish partial TABLECONTENT.
AC1024 inline parsing retains the validated prefix and cursor at TABLECONTENT start.
A table populated with linked-data fields is refused before a destination file is published.

controls.route: dwg2dxf adapter fallback; generated ASCII and binary DXF round-trip
assertions: An incomplete linked TABLE is exported only through its existing INSERT fallback.
Readback contains exactly one INSERT with the expected table block name and no semantic ACAD_TABLE record.

doesNotEstablish: AC1024 inline field retention in the public DRW_Table because incomplete content is intentionally not published
DATALINK object dispatch/callback retention, owner graph, or complete conversion closure
DXF TABLECONTENT/DATALINK emission or role-aware handle remapping
native 2D/3D application behavior or all-version DWG/DXF parity

completedSlices: 7G.3d.3b typed linked-cell and ATTDEF field capture (content-ordinal association remains open)
planImpact.nextSlice: 7G.3d.3c producer-backed TABLECONTENT/DATALINK owner and reference census, followed by atomic DXF graph routing
